name: k4-d2-interference
comment: Dimension 2 on 4 vertices where one non-monochromatic colouring (0,0,1,1) is feasible with two matchings whose weights cancel: 1 * (-1) + 1 * 1 = 0. Exercises destructive interference and bichromatic edges, which is the regime Bogdanov's lemma forces any counterexample into.
